messages:
maya: Quick capacity check — where are we on the dedicated GPU nodes for cluster-west? Need final go/no-go for the canary run on Mon morning. cc @alex @sam @li

alex: Procurement update: 8x H100 nodes cleared customs yesterday. Rack assignments done, just waiting on PDUs. ETA for fully-cabled & racked: Mon 06:00 PT. Serial prefixes: H100-AX4*, H100-BX9* :package:

sam: Power/cabling team says PDUs arrive Sun night. Networking scheduled for Mon 01:00-03:00 PT. I'll be on shift for the test. :wrench:

li: Reservation mapping done — reserved_capacity_id rc-4821 mapped to cluster-west-canary. Provisioning rules applied (spread across availability zones). I also pushed a small change to autoscaler to prefer dedicated pool for canary traffic.

maya: Thx. Who's owning the runtime bake + smoke tests? I can run the application-level smoke, but need the low-level KV/cache checks.

nina: Eng-SRE here — heads up we have a maintenance window Mon 05:30-06:30 PT for the storage controllers in us-west-2. That conflicts with the Monday 06:00 ETA. Suggest we shift canary to Tue 09:00 PT to avoid rollback noise. :alarm_clock:

deploy-bot: canary-cluster-west provisioned -> cluster-west-canary-rc-4821 (provision_id: prov-8812) :white_check_mark:

alex: Ah, missed that storage window — good catch, @nina. We can complete rack/power on Mon but won't run canary until Tue. Final commissioning tasks: firmware updates (queued), burn-in tests (2h), network verification (30m).

maya: OK let's move canary to Tue 09:00 PT. Can someone confirm autoscaler min/max for the canary pool? Need to ensure we don't oversubscribe during the test.

li: Autoscaler config for rc-4821: min:2 max:10 target_cpu:60. I pushed the config to infra-configs repo and created PR #824. Link: https://repo/infra-configs/pull/824 :link:

sam: I'll run the rack-level smoke and post logs. Quick smoke command we'll use:

```
curl -sS http://canary-west.internal/health | jq .
ssh gpu-node-01 'cat /var/log/ignite/init.log | tail -n 50'
```

alex: Firmware update window scheduled Mon 22:00-00:00 PT (non-blocking for rack). Commissioning complete Tue 03:00 PT. Burn-in finishes Tue 05:30 PT. All good for Tue 09:00 slot from infra side. :thumbsup:

nina: I'll set the SRE on-call to monitor 08:30-11:30 Tue and draft the rollback checklist. Please add the following to runbook: node power-cycle steps, nvlink validation, fallback model route (redwood:model-small-v2). I'll post the doc.

maya: Awesome — owners: eng-runtime (maya), eng-infra (alex), eng-platform (li), eng-sre (nina). Runbook owner: sam (smoke logs). Moving target: Tue 09:00 PT. I'll paste the runbook here when ready. :rocket:

sam: Adding my checklist to the runbook now, ping me for any last-minute changes. :eyes:
